  SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.IsLocalizingInvariant Φ →
    {C D E : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.StableCategory} →
      (p : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap C E) →
        (q : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap D E) →

              (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.value Φ
                (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.laxCategory p q)) ≅
            SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.SpectrumHo.obj
              (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.Binary.obj (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.value Φ C)

    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap A

  (q : SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap D E)

    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap A
      (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.laxCategory p q))
  (r :
    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Stable.Verdier.ExactMap
      (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.laxCategory p q) Q)

      (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.Derived.Lax.IsLocalizingInvariant.laxQuotientProductFiberLeftIso hΦ p q i r

    SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.SpectrumHo.hom
      (SerrePositivity.KST.LocalizingInvariants.IsLocalizingInvariant.laxQuotientProductInclusion p q i)
